sources.entry: Libredesk - Modern omnichannel customer support desk. Live chat, email, and more in a single binary. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Go/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: LibreDesk is a self-hosted customer support desk that handles email, live chat, and WhatsApp conversations in a single binary.
summary.what_it_does: LibreDesk provides a shared inbox where email, live chat, and WhatsApp (via the Meta Cloud API) conversations are handled together. It includes a live chat widget for websites, teams, tags, custom statuses, attributes, snoozing, and search for organizing conversations. The README also describes a multilingual help center, an AI assistant that answers live chat questions from the knowledge base and hands off to agents, and an agent copilot for drafting replies and summaries. Workflow features include automations, macros, auto assignment by agent capacity, SLA targets with at-risk notifications, CSAT surveys, and analytics. Administration covers role-based permissions, SSO via Google, Microsoft, or OIDC providers, activity logs, and an API with webhooks.
use_cases: shared team inbox for customer email and chat
embed live chat widget on a website
SLA and CSAT tracking for support agents
how_to_run: Binary: ./libredesk --install (sets up Postgres DB), then ./libredesk --set-system-user-password, then ./libredesk
notable: Combines email, live chat, and WhatsApp in one inbox
Built-in AI assistant grounded in the help center knowledge base
One-click Railway deploy provisions app, Postgres, and Redis
caveats: WhatsApp requires connecting a number through the Meta Cloud API
Binary install requires setting up a Postgres database manually
Full feature set is described on the external website rather than in the README
